description_en: Adds an IPv6 network interface controller (NIC). A public IP address is automatically assigned at the same time
description_zh: 调用AddNetworkInterfaceToInstance增加IPv6网卡且同时自动分配公网IP
kebab_example: aliyun ens add-network-interface-to-instance --instance-id yourInstance_ID --networks ipType_:_public_,_ipAddressType_:_ipv6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddNetworkInterfaceToInstance

parameters.help_en: The network. The value is a JSON string. Only IPv6 is supported. Sample code of an IPv6 network: [{ "ipType": "public", "ipAddressType": "ipv6" }]
parameters.name: networks

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically restart the instance
parameters.name: auto_start
